name: Haas VF-2 vertical machining centre
about: Links from Haas's VF-2 STEP (moonshot/library/stations/extract.py; bounds in vf2.links.json), in the world frame with the table top at z = 853 mm and the operator at -Y. Joint zero is the STEP's pose: table at the left end of X, saddle at the front of Y, head at the top of Z, doors closed.

masses_source.reason: Haas publishes the machine's 3,400 kg total, not per-link masses; the servo axes are position-controlled, so these only set inertia

y.reason: Haas VF-2: 16 in Y travel, 1000 in/min rapids

x.reason: Haas VF-2: 30 in X travel, 1000 in/min rapids

z.reason: Haas VF-2: 20 in Z travel (spindle nose 4-24 in above the table), 1000 in/min rapids

door_left.reason: The doors slide open by hand; about 600 mm each clears the opening

table_top.reason: The CAD's shells aren't closed; trainual measured this box from the GLB

door_right.reason: Sliding doors overlap at different depths: the right one runs 20 mm behind the left

affordances_source.reason: Placed on the CAD's door edges and pendant face; to be checked against the render

interlocks: cycle_start runs a program only with both doors closed
opening a door while running puts the machine in feed_hold and stops the spindle
the spindle turns only while running
